# Stop — please do not file this issue.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in QuantumSSH,
**please do not file a public issue**. Public issues are visible to
everyone, including potential attackers, before a fix is available.

Instead, please follow the embargoed-disclosure process described in
[`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md):

- Email: `security@quantumssh.org`
- PGP key fingerprint: see `SECURITY.md`
- Default embargo: 90 days, extensible to 120 days
- We acknowledge reports within 72 business hours

We credit reporters in release notes and advisories. We coordinate CVE
assignment through MITRE.

If you are not sure whether your finding is a vulnerability, please err
on the side of reporting privately. We will tell you quickly if it is
out of scope, and you can re-file as a normal bug or feature request.

Thank you for taking the time to report responsibly.
